title: Updates
subtitle: Pelagos releases and engine packages, node by node, with checks and rollback

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.name: Node
nodes.firstPassage: No node keeps a previous package yet: the version before was installed by hand. A rollback after this first update from the screen needs the previous release uploaded again.

available.title: Available releases
available.minUpgrade: This release upgrades from {{version}} or later only: {{nodes}} must be updated by hand first.
available.uploadHelp: Upload sends the files of a release folder: packages, SHA256SUMS, SHA256SUMS.sig, release.json, NOTES.md.
available.none: No release is known yet: check now or upload a release folder.
available.blocked: A rollout is active: resume, cancel or roll it back before preparing another one.

clusterRollback.title: Cluster rollback
clusterRollback.help: Reinstalls {{version}}, the package kept by the last update, on every node that keeps it, in the reverse order, with the same checks.

steps.journal: No new error in the journal

source.title: Release source and pace

help.upload: Releases are uploaded from this screen: works without Internet access and with a private repository.
help.github: The service node reads the latest release of the repository at each check interval; a token is needed for a private repository (Contents read only is enough).
help.repository: The apt or dnf repository of Pelagos, read by the package manager.

source.tokenStored: A token is stored (encrypted). Type a new one to replace it.
source.tokenHelp: Optional, for a private repository. Stored encrypted, never shown again.

toast.uploadedUnsigned: Release {{version}} uploaded: {{signature}}. It installs only after the extra confirmation.

preview.unsigned: Release {{version}} is not signed: its origin is not verified.
preview.unknownKey: Release {{version}} is signed by an unknown key ({{key}}): its origin is not verified.
preview.unsignedHelp: The SHA256SUMS sums are still checked, but nothing proves who built these packages. Root installs them on every node. Go on only for a release you built or downloaded yourself.
preview.unsignedAccept: I accept to install a release whose origin is not verified
preview.orderHelp: One node at a time; the next starts after the pause once the previous is done. By default the DNS primary and the Kea HA primary go last.
preview.autoRollbackHelp: Reinstalls the previous package on the failing node when the release keeps the state schema.
preview.schemaChanged: This release changes the state schema: no automatic rollback. A failure stops the rollout and the manual procedure applies.
preview.stale: The order or the option changed: compute the plan again.
preview.passwordRequired: Type your password to apply the update.

rollout.reconnecting: The node serving this page is restarting (since {{since}}): the page reconnects by itself and reads the rollout again. Nothing depends on it staying open.
rollout.reconnected: Reconnected: the rollout state is read again from the cluster.
rollout.stopped: The rollout stopped at {{node}}; the next nodes did not start.
rollout.autoRolledBack: The node went back to its previous package automatically. Fix the cause, then resume, cancel the rest or roll back the nodes already done.
rollout.schemaChanged: This release changed the state schema, so the node was not rolled back automatically. Follow the rollback procedure of the upgrade guide (pelagos settings --legacy, then the state backup of the node), then resume or cancel.
rollout.failedHelp: Fix the cause, then resume. Cancel the rest leaves the nodes already done on the new version.
rollout.cancelTitle: Cancel the rest of the rollout?
rollout.cancelHelp: Nodes not started are skipped. Nodes already done stay on the new version: a cluster with two versions is supported.
rollout.rollbackTitle: Roll back the nodes already updated?
rollout.rollbackHelp: Starts a rollout back to the previous version over the nodes already done, in the reverse order. The current rollout ends cancelled.
